## Physical Memory Layout Conventions

- RAM assumed contiguous from physical `$00000` upward, in 2K/4K-aligned blocks; OS-9 auto-scans for it at startup.
- Bootstrap ROM: at least 4K at `$FF000-$FFFFF` (reset vector, MMU init, ~3K of kernel) - worth noting the Designers Guide is internally inconsistent here: its MMU-chip-selection discussion frames this same 4K figure as a not-to-exceed ceiling ("should not exceed 4K bytes in total"), while its system-memory-map section frames it as a floor ("should be at least 4K bytes"). The memory-map section's "at least," 2K/4K-block-aligned framing is treated as authoritative here since it's the address-map-specific passage. Op
